disclaimer.title: About how territories are shown
disclaimer.text: The depiction of territories, boundaries and names on this map does not imply any position of the authors on the legal status of any territory, state or authority. The map shows de facto control and the parties' claims on the selected date, based on open sources. The positions of the parties, the UN and international courts are set out in the detail cards with references. The data is being reviewed and may contain errors; records that need review are marked.
